Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by hawkish Fed commentary from Chairman Warsh, signaling potential rate hikes and higher Treasury yields. This is a direct headwind for your concentrated tech/chip portfolio, as higher rates typically hurt growth stocks and increase margin costs.

Your holdings: SOXL (-56.1%) and SPAL (-41.23%) are major concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, decaying assets, and deeply in the red. SMH (-12.82%) and QQQI (-3.34%) are also flagged for trimming. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further Fed comments and Treasury yield movements. Also, monitor the performance of your leveraged ETFs, as they are particularly vulnerable in this environment.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management, especially on your leveraged and underperforming positions.
plays: Respect stops on SMH (540) and QQQI (52). These are flagged for trimming, and the macro environment suggests caution.
Seriously consider reducing exposure to SOXL and SPAL. Both are leveraged, decaying, and deeply negative; their default stops may not be enough.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The current market signals caution for tech/growth names.
